title: Richard Turpin — Onboarding Complete
description: Richard Turpin enters the world in Hempstead, Essex. Fifth of six children. Early career in butchery before pivoting to more entrepreneurial pursuits.

title: Gregory Group Founded
description: Samuel Gregory incorporates the Gregory Group, initially focused on rural procurement in Epping Forest. Deer are involved. Paperwork is minimal.

title: Essex Solutions Merger — Gregory Group Acquired
description: The Gregory Group merges with Turpin's operations to form Essex Solutions Group. Highway corridor management added to the portfolio.

title: King Equine Partnership Announced
description: Turpin partners with Matthew King to launch King Equine Partners. Gentleman's agreements become a core competency.

title: King Equine — Contract Termination at Whitechapel
description: Matthew King's employment concludes following an incident at Whitechapel. Exit interview not completed.

title: Project Yorkshire — John Palmer Identity Provisioned
description: Turpin relocates to Yorkshire under the John Palmer alias. Ned Palmer provisions SSO credentials. Brazier Legal handles documentation.

title: Beverley Audit — Identity Mismatch Detected
description: Turpin arrested for equine acquisition irregularities at Beverley. John Palmer account flagged; deduplication review initiated.

title: York Due Diligence Review — Regulatory Proceedings
description: Turpin's transaction history reviewed at York Assizes. York Due Diligence Partners find the horse in the transaction. Outcome: contract terminated.

title: Project Knavesmire — Contract Termination, York Site
description: Richard Turpin's employment concluded at York Knavesmire. Conducted himself with remarkable composure at the offboarding ceremony.

title: Black Bess — Overnight London-York Feasibility Study (Disputed)
description: Victorian folklore attributes an impossible overnight ride from London to York to Turpin and his mare Black Bess. Finance disputes the mileage. Catherine Bell owns the narrative.

title: Epping Forest — Sector 7 Enforcement Intensified
description: Forest wardens intensify patrols following a surge in unauthorised procurement attributed to the Gregory Group. William Hargreaves leads the response.

title: Turpinverse Canon Published — Legend Meets CRM
description:
The Turpinverse open-source canon dataset is published for CRM demo and documentation use. Catherine Bell approves the brand guidelines.
